Property due to negligence, carelessness on the pa rt of the workmen employed by the contractor, shall be made good by the contractor at his own co st. The FDR of PG will be refunded after success ful completion of contract duly deducting the cost of damages if any as mentioned above. This means Mobile phones are to be provided to the driver of the vehicle e ngaged. The numbers are to be informed to concerned depot in-charge, where the service/vehicle is provided. Notification and documentary evid ence. This will also be applicable for the work done during the extended period, if such extension i s on Railway’s account. However, if the extension of contract period is on account of failure of contractor, no compensatio n shall be made toward revision or imposition of any new taxes.

Any benefit on account of downward revision of duty/GST/taxes/cess either in original period or d uring the extended contract shall be passed on by the contractor to the Railways.
